entities.summary: Nils Hjelmtveit was a Norwegian educator and politician for the Labour Party. He was mayor of Stokken Municipality, MP from 1925 to 1930, Minister of Education and Church Affairs from 1935 to 1945 and County Governor of Aust-Agder from 1945 to 1961.
